text: seow: 'the stack is not my test.' It is mine, and it runs first (C3). ma50 18.57 under ma100 19.46 and ma200 19.8 fails criteria 2 and 4; ret_12m -8.59. You call your own case thin, ret_63d 8.58, and wyckoff reads day_vol 0.94 as an advance without effort; C6 says the same: a move on light volume is not genuine. A 20-day thrust over the 200-day inside an inverted stack is stage 1 repair (C2). I hold OPPOSE. The one observable that moves me: ma50 back over a rising ma200.
